title: Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing): Recovery Room Rate per Unit for Outpatient Surgery
content:
| Payer class | Recovery (revenue code 0710) rate per counted unit |
|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim | 310.00 USD |
| Commercial HMO Claim | 285.00 USD |
| otherwise (a Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim) | its charges per counted unit times the expected allowed percentage |

This rate schedule applies to the recovery lines of an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing). The recovery lines are valued at their counted units times that rate, never above their charges, its counted units being its billed units, or one when it is billed with charges but no units.

Example (hypothetical): 2 units on a Commercial HMO Claim with charges of 1,000.00 → 570.00.
